column1: # How each sense of a Swedish word is said, where one spelling has senses that sound different.
# Kind and headword name one of the form's senses, as tools/lexicon/build_study.py writes them; the gloss
# is given only where two senses share both. Phonemes are what read-aloud says for the form: the word's own
# pronunciation, or that of its phrases in resources/corpus/pronunciation-sv.tsv, which decide the place.
# Word study shows the sense whose phonemes read-aloud uses at the clicked word first.
